identify: Small black spots appear on the older leaves.
The spots grow and show rings like a bull's eye. The tissue around the spot may turn yellow.
damage: The disease can kill much of the leaves in hot and humid weather. It also spots the stem and the fruit.

cultural: Change the nursery bed location every season.

safety: Spray only when the disease is seen on the crop. Wear gloves and a mask when you spray.
